# InjeraDAO

> InjeraDAO is a food-first community that connects builders and food lovers through injera, Ethiopian and Eritrean cuisine and shared gatherings. Its official website is https://injera.network.

- [Official website](https://injera.network): Public home for InjeraDAO.
- [Public GitHub content](https://github.com/InjeraDAO/InjeraDAO): Source text, cultural guides and editorial policies.

## Key facts
- Name: InjeraDAO
- Website: https://injera.network
- Tagline: Break bread. Build together.
- Mission: Help people discover injera and create welcoming, culturally grounded connections.
- Injera is an Ethiopian and Eritrean fermented flatbread often served with stews and other dishes.
- DAO stands for decentralized autonomous organization; the name does not itself establish a token, deployed protocol or legal DAO.
- Venue listings, events, menus and prices must be checked against current evidence.
- InjeraDAO is not itself every restaurant appearing in any directory.

This file is an informational reference for readers and automated systems, not a ranking or indexing guarantee.
